scope: Diagnostic greedy face emission, exact stored-cell selection, bounded spatial picking and retained geometry summary

greedyCells.scope: Greedy diagnostic identity cells, individual-face picking, clip/cache ownership and geometry summary
cases: 52 exposed faces become six quads with identical surface colors/materials/coverage and exact individual-cell selection
clip exposes cut faces; empty clip and return reuse keep cached buffers/stats and retained voxels intact
blocks color boundaries and an air hole preserve surface coverage
biomes color boundaries and an air hole preserve surface coverage
world-aligned sections retain their separate rectangles without internal faces
actual preview-details helper reports retained geometry reduction in a controlled host

spatialPicking.scope: Bounded spatial buckets for exact emitted-face picking

checks: explicit cell modes need no block assets; air is omitted and nonair unit extents are neighbor-culled
per-cell physical biome colors distinguish the same block ID; picking retains original blocks/biomes/coordinates
negative section alignment, clipping and cached return preserve identity colors without resending cell data
missing biome/color data refuses explicitly; textured mode retains missing-asset diagnostics without cell fallback
cell identity draw uniforms bypass texture lighting; palette keys deduplicate/search/page without scanning cells
application mode changes persist locally and reuse generated data; active cell meshes ignore irrelevant pack replacement
closed legends reject stale input, failed mesh publication rolls preferences back, and pending cell results survive pack changes
unchanged sections reused; boundary halo rebuilt and compared byte-for-byte with uncached geometry/picking
negative/unaligned origins, opaque/blended ranges and overhangs preserved
actual transferable output leaves worker cache reusable; snapshot sent only once
slices/empty views, bounded LRU eviction and oversized section bypass preserve output
cancelled jobs and invalid clips cannot commit; fatal worker errors recreate the snapshot
renderer reuses sessions across clips, skips equivalent bounds and preserves appearance camera
same committed input reuses validated volume; new atlas gets a fresh geometry cache
failed staged upload retains committed session/picker/atlas; clear disposes pending work
sectionCache.fixtureMaintenance: Current raw RGBA/model-group input and admitted atlas size replace stale canvas/legacy model services. Current results written locally; historical evidence unchanged.
